OBS-web is a browser-based application that allows users to remotely control OBS Studio, offering features like scene switching, stream/recording control, and live preview. It requires OBS version 28+ and the obs-websocket plugin, and can be accessed locally or over the internet via WSS tunnels.

This is a client-only web application built with TypeScript and Vite that helps users configure AllowedIPs for AmneziaWG/WireGuard VPNs. It allows users to select inclusion/exclusion strategies, integrate system service lists, and add manual CIDRs to generate a single, clean line of configuration for their VPN peer settings, all stored locally in the browser.
